infeasibility_report.reason: Walk-forward realized turnover round-trip = 6.426/yr exceeds hard fail threshold 6.0/yr (Hurdle Gate v2.2). Per-date alpha ranking induces high name churn (avg 6.7/20 names changed monthly). Buffer-zone (rank ≤ 30 keep) experiment was prepared but did not complete in time budget. Without buffer zone, current schedule generates ~268% one-way annual turnover = 535% round-trip excluding the as-of anchor jump. With anchor included, round-trip ≈ 642%. TDC q5 = 0 (PASS) and CVaR(5%) = -0.099 (within tail-adjusted cap) suggest portfolio-level orthogonality is achieved, but at cost of high churn.
infeasibility_report.suggested_resolution: Three-pronged remediation required for downstream admission: (1) Re-run with buffer zone (rank ≤ 30 keep) to bring turnover < 3-4/yr; (2) Add explicit CVaR-budget constraint (Σ w_i CVaR_i ≤ -0.025/mo) to MVO objective; (3) EWMA alpha smoothing (lambda 0.6-0.8) to dampen ranking volatility. Forge can either: (a) accept current schedule with documented hard fail (NAV will erode 96bps/yr in costs + tail-risk uncovered), or (b) trigger Optimizer re-run with above mitigation. Per Charter §8: NOT a silent override.
